(async()=>{ __app.showTab('library'); const t0=Date.now(); let c; for(let i=0;i<120;i++){ c=[...document.querySelectorAll('.muted')].map(x=>x.textContent).find(t=>/[0-9] items?$/.test(t)); if(c && c!=='0 items') break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const g=document.querySelector('.vgrid'); const sz=g.querySelector('.vgrid-sizer'); const all=g.querySelectorAll('.tile'); return { waitedMs: Date.now()-t0, count: c, sizer: sz.style.height, tilesInDom: all.length, gClient: g.clientWidth + 'x' + g.clientHeight, scrollH: g.scrollHeight, t0: all[0] && all[0].style.transform, tLast: all[all.length-1] && all[all.length-1].style.transform }; })()

(async()=>{ const g=document.querySelector('.vgrid'); const times=[]; for (let i=0;i<20;i++){ const t=performance.now(); g.scrollTop += 900; await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(r))); times.push(performance.now()-t); } return { scrollTop: g.scrollTop, maxFrameMs: Math.round(Math.max(...times)), avgMs: Math.round(times.reduce((a,b)=>a+b)/times.length), tilesInDom: g.querySelectorAll('.tile').length }; })()
